1. Root cause: Correct. With `pipefail`, `git log` receiving SIGPIPE yields 141; the assignment becomes nonzero and `-e` aborts the step.

2. Behavioral equivalence: Yes. `--no-merges` filters merge commits, then `--max-count=20` limits the resulting output to 20 commits. This matches `--no-merges | head -20`. Git documents both as commit-limiting options. [Git 2.53 documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log/2.53.0)

3. SIGPIPE removal: Complete for this line. There is no early-closing downstream process; command substitution consumes all 20 Git-generated lines.

4. Comment accuracy: Accurate. It correctly says failure occurs only if Git is still writing, so it does not claim every branch over 20 commits deterministically fails. Minor precision improvement would be “more than 20 non-merge commits,” but this is non-blocking.

5. Defects introduced: None. No correctness, security, shell, whitespace, or YAML defect found.
